page.overview:
Who is People Devil?

The の|Hito no Akuma}} is a Devil who embodies the concept of people.

The People Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The People Devil's personality is currently unknown.

The People Devil is first mentioned by one of Fumiko Mifune's clones, one of whom identified the public as her greatest fear.
